user.title: Connect to WA Synergy
user.description: Enter the URL and API token configured in the WA Synergy companion app. Optionally select your plan to show GST-inclusive published rates effective 1 July 2026. This only configures Home Assistant; it does not change your Synergy contract. K1 is usage-tiered and has no single hourly price. Current rates must not be used to cost delayed historical usage.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to WA Synergy
reauth_confirm.description: Update the companion service connection details.

init.title: Electricity tariff
init.description: Select the plan on your Synergy contract, or leave pricing unconfigured. This only changes Home Assistant, not your Synergy contract. Rates include GST and are effective 1 July 2026, with hourly periods in Perth time. K1 has daily usage tiers: the current hourly price remains unknown and separate sensors show each tier. Current rates must not be used to cost delayed historical usage.
